title: 高风险运行插件、外部连接器与 Native Attachment First 闭环

baseline.handoff_2_0_14: 4bfe0c3 tree-identical to protected main 5f8c54d; source contracts only, installed/public closure remains T18

root_causes.native_attachment: The pinned Vision client owned a second paste path: it prevented the native composer event, uploaded PNG bytes to a Vision-only HTTP route, and inserted an absolute filesystem-path marker as message text. Paste therefore bypassed the native Attachment/ImageBlock owner and could duplicate or lose multi-image inputs.
root_causes.text_only_boundary: T10 exposed an authoritative tri-state image-input contract, but no runtime consumer converted native image blocks for confirmed text-only models at the ephemeral model request boundary.
root_causes.frozen_request: Real Agent Loop GenerateOptions are deep-frozen and process-locally marked. Recursively calling ctx.llm.stream with a converted clone re-entered llm/stream outside the PreparedLlmCall and lost its captured adapter registration, exact request identity and marker.
root_causes.vision_startup: The managed Vision adapter initialized Python and wheels during plugin apply even when no Vision capability was used.
root_causes.cdp: The native CDP owner already used visible installed Chrome, loopback-only CDP and first-use launch, but its prompt did not state the T05 latest-explicit-visible-page exclusion strongly enough.
root_causes.computer_use_handoff: D016 found that T15 had retained the native ComputerUseService status and permission actions but had not projected them through emateCapabilities, leaving T13 with no native helper/TCC metadata and a forbidden navigator.userAgent/platform inference.
root_causes.find_skill: The 2.0.14 handoff already replaced shell-shim launch with direct packaged Electron-as-Node pnpm, but its regression exercised only --version rather than the named Feishu installation arguments that previously surfaced EINVAL.

resolution.native_attachment: The Vision build adapter removes only the staged upstream installPasteImages registration, bundled paste module, Host paste backend and Vision-only HTTP route. The existing DSH composer and Attachment store remain the sole paste, drag/drop and upload owner; no upstream source or second Attachment store was changed or added.
resolution.text_only_boundary: Native image blocks remain unchanged for image-capable and metadata-unknown models. Only confirmed text-only plus convert-at-request-boundary calls read the existing Attachment store, describe temporary 0600 image files through the lazy Vision runtime, scrub the temporary path, and construct a transient wire request. The durable Session request and image blocks remain unchanged.
resolution.waterfall_order: The bounded Harness change adds the sole llm/wire waterfall after the original llm/stream/T10/invariant path and immediately before the captured adapter dispatch. It may replace only messages, deep-freezes a converted request, preserves every envelope field by identity, keeps the PreparedLlmCall registration across HMR rebind, returns the original request object when no transform occurs, and fails closed on throw, abort or envelope drift. Vision now registers only this seam and never recursively calls ctx.llm.stream.
resolution.lazy_runtime: Managed apply registers tools, Skill and the request bridge against one lazy runtime proxy. The pinned offline-wheel manager prepares on the first actual runtime method call; a Settings generation invalidates a pending preparation before the next call. Non-managed upstream behavior remains eager.
resolution.cdp: The existing native prompt now limits CDP to the latest explicit request to read or operate a visible Chrome page and excludes attachments, image generation, native apps and non-page work. Existing loopback, first-use browser launch and native mutation approval remain unchanged.
resolution.computer_use: D016 source/component correction: the build adapter adds one fail-closed upstream Bundle seam that registers exactly one computer-use definition through the existing emateCapabilities effect lifecycle. Listing reads only cached ComputerUseService.status(); ready requires the helper plus granted Accessibility and Screen Recording, missing permissions expose only their matching openPermissionSettings action, and provider failure is failed/blocked with no executable action. The existing explicit-current-turn authority, native approval, universal macOS helper and Windows platform gate remain unchanged.
resolution.find_skill: No runtime source change was needed. The existing direct packaged pnpm route and exact persistent receipt owner were retained; the regression now executes the pinned lark-doc add arguments and asserts the Electron-as-Node argv that bypasses the shell-shim EINVAL path.
